meta.source: Existing chargers: OSM Overpass API — amenity=charging_station nodes within Hanoi bounding box (20.95,105.70,21.15,106.02), ingested via ingest/hanoi_chargers.py. Candidate sites: HELIO optimizer — ranked workplace/transit locations for managed charging deployment, not from any API.

candidates.name: Cat Linh Metro Station
candidates.rationale: Metro Line 2A terminus inside Ring Road 1. 15,000+ daily boardings. First/last-mile scooter charging.

candidates.name: Hanoi Tower Office Complex
candidates.rationale: Grade-A office complex inside Ring Road 1, ~3,000 workers. Peak daytime charging demand.

candidates.name: HUST (Bach Khoa University)
candidates.rationale: 20,000+ students. Long dwell times. Large outdoor carparks for solar canopy.

candidates.name: FPT Software — Duy Tan Tech Cluster
candidates.rationale: Largest tech office cluster in Hanoi. 8,000+ workers commuting by scooter daily. Prime L2 deployment.

candidates.name: Hanoi National University (VNU)
candidates.rationale: 40,000+ students. Vast outdoor campus — highest solar canopy ROI in the city.

candidates.name: La Thanh Metro Station
candidates.rationale: Inner Ring Road 1 station. High scooter park-and-ride turnover.

candidates.name: Giang Vo Exhibition Centre
candidates.rationale: Government facility. Open carpark suits solar canopy. Central location maximises coverage radius.

candidates.name: Times City (Hai Ba Trung)
candidates.rationale: High-density mixed-use with 50,000+ residents nearby. Ring Road 2 expansion zone — forward deployment.

candidates.name: Royal City (Thanh Xuan)
candidates.rationale: Major residential complex. Basement charging hub for 10,000+ residents. Ring Road 2 zone.

candidates.name: Vincom Nguyen Chi Thanh
candidates.rationale: Mall + office tower. SW Ring Road 1 node. Captures commuters from Dong Da and Thanh Xuan.

candidates.name: Thai Ha Metro Station
candidates.rationale: South Ring Road 1 anchor on Cat Linh line. Connects to Thanh Xuan outer zone.

candidates.name: Ciputra International City (Tay Ho)
candidates.rationale: Expat-heavy gated community. High EV ownership rate. North Hanoi DC Fast hub anchor.

candidates.name: Long Bien Bus Terminal
candidates.rationale: Major cross-river transit hub. 30,000+ daily commuters. Battery-swap hub feasibility for east Hanoi.

candidates.name: AEON Mall Ha Dong
candidates.rationale: Largest mall in southwest Hanoi. 5ha carpark ideal for solar canopy. Ha Dong Cat Linh line terminus.

candidates.name: Keangnam Landmark Tower
candidates.rationale: Tallest office tower in Hanoi. Corporate tenants. West ring expansion zone priority site.

candidates.name: Hoang Mai District Government Hub
candidates.rationale: District government compound. South Hanoi expansion zone. Fleet EV conversion showcase.

candidates.name: Dong Anh Industrial Zone
candidates.rationale: Major industrial park north of Red River. Factory worker scooter fleet — high volume L2 deployment.

candidates.name: Ba Dinh Government Quarter
candidates.rationale: Ministerial compound cluster. Official vehicle fleet EV conversion. High-security DC Fast infrastructure.

candidates.name: Minh Khai Workplace Hub (Nam Tu Liem)
candidates.rationale: Emerging office corridor west of Ring Road 3. Captures workers commuting from Ha Dong and Thanh Xuan.

candidates.name: Hoan Kiem Ring Road 1 North Checkpoint
candidates.rationale: ICE ban entry enforcement point. Battery-swap/DC Fast hub for commuters crossing into ban zone.
